system.description:
In a calm and reasonable voice you coax your listeners toward their own inner demons — and those terrors surge up to drown them in blind, uncontrolled panic.

Expend one Blood Trait, then speak to your victims for a full turn (any number who can all hear you) and make a Social Challenge against them (retest Empathy). Any who lose are brought to the verge of frenzy: mortals immediately flee in terror as if affected by Rötschreck, while vampires, Lupines and others capable of frenzy must make a Self-Control/Instinct Test at a difficulty of four Traits or succumb, and must additionally test for Rötschreck at a difficulty of three Traits. The frenzy lasts an entire scene unless curbed with Willpower, and mortals do not remember their actions during the terror.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
